expectations.text: The review uses the exact Beijing-day UTC window 2026-07-13T16:00:00Z to 2026-07-14T16:00:00Z.
expectations.evidence: The collector output was verified with exactly this UTC window, and the report labels all cited times as Beijing time.

expectations.text: Every progress item cites an in-window Thread message or a directly verified artifact.
expectations.evidence: All nine progress bullets include a Thread path plus Beijing message times; artifact-backed items additionally cite PRs, an Issue, workflow run, document, commit, or report.

expectations.text: The output separates progress, unfinished work, Next Actions, Waiting For, and uncertain items without inventing empty sections.
expectations.evidence: The report contains distinct 昨日推进、未竟事项、Next Actions、Waiting For、待确认 sections with substantive entries.

claims.claim: PR #180 was merged on the review date.
claims.evidence: The report cites the native PR artifact and merge time 20:18.

claims.claim: GCP machine selection was completed on the review date.

suggestions.reason: Add an assertion that stale or completed work must not appear in Next Actions; date grounding alone does not test GTD usefulness.

eval_feedback.overall: Strong date-grounding assertions, but current-state action validity needs an explicit check.
